args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) since its deploy, with error rate at 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Checked status and deployment history for checkout-api.
   - Current version: **v2.3.1** — unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), error rate 0.18.
   - Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (seq 3) as the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (seq 1).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.
